name: Baseten
tagline: Baseten is a model inference infrastructure platform for deploying AI models in production with fast cold start times. ML teams use it to serve custom models, fine-tuned checkpoints, and open-source models like Llama through a simple API without managing GPU clusters. It handles autoscaling and caching so models stay responsive under variable traffic without unnecessary compute costs.
